def moveY(self, move):
        self.y += move
        p = self.parent
        ir = p.inner_rect
        r = self.rect
        if r.y < ir.y: r.y = p.y
        elif r.top > ir.top: r.top = ir.top
        range = p.maximum - p.minimum
        p.changeCurrent((self.y - ir.y) * float(range) / (ir.height - self.height))
